notablePrerequisites:
Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn has a power of at least eight.
description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Mobilize by paying {G}, untapping all creatures you control.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Timeless Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Timeless Witness by paying {2}{G}{G}.
Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, returning Mobilize from your graveyard to your hand.
